tldr: Mars through the 7th house brings focus to partnerships, clients, contracts, and direct others.
body: Mars transiting the 7th house energizes partnerships, clients, contracts, and direct others. For about six weeks, drive, heat, conflict, desire, and action move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is an activation transit: it brings momentum and courage, but also heat that needs a clear outlet.
business: Mars supports relationship dynamics and agreements: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Impulsiveness, conflict, burnout, or handing your agency to someone else.
advice: Aim the fire in the 7th house deliberately. Work with partnerships, clients, contracts, and direct others without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from Marie Satori house-transit material.
